title: Choose the NFT Standard Boundary
description: Distinguish NFT ownership data from a display string or royalty convention.

content.prompt: What is the safest description of an on-chain NFT standard?
options: A contract interface and storage/event conventions for ownership and metadata
A JPG file stored in a wallet

solution: A contract interface and storage/event conventions for ownership and metadata
hint: Standards make independent clients agree on ownership, metadata, transfer, and event behavior.
